set.body: PRD G-3..G-7. Sealed ADT retaining structure with render: String. Cases Id, Affine, Tangent (carrying Viewing and Sense so it is genuinely invertible), Homography, Then. Every case private; Then reachable only via andThen, which checks f.to.id == g.from.id and returns Either[FrameMismatch, _]. Px->Deg only via a Viewing value.
set.title: Warp ADT with private constructors and checked composition
